target_customer: Utilities, energy asset owners, O&M companies and data center operators (Altenia, Terna and TotalEnergies named on its site)
problem: Operating power plants involves triaging alarms, dispatching technicians and reporting across fragmented SCADA and work order systems.
business_model: Enterprise deployments with forward deployed engineers building AI agents inside customer systems
product_category: AI agents for energy plant operations

founders.name: Joseph Perrotta
founders.background_notes: Former professional volleyball player; leads go to market.

founders.name: Kaan Durmaz
founders.background_notes: Worked on computer vision, differential privacy and AI for chemistry; first author of a TMLR 2026 paper.

competitors.name: Emerson Ovation AI Agents
competitors.what: Human in the loop AI agents for power and water plants
competitors.traction_then: First five agents slated for release in the fall

competitors.name: UptimeAI
competitors.what: AI reasoning agents for critical industrial operations unveiled at CERAWeek

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must integrate with SCADA and work order systems, handle time series data and run securely in customer VMs, which is difficult for a young team.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration and approved agent workflows inside utilities create lock in, but incumbents like Emerson are shipping similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent control vendors launched plant agents in 2026; no acquisition of Invertix found.

market_need_then: Traditional SCADA mainly supplies raw data; the company claims about 1.8 to 2 GW managed and over 10 GW of commercial opportunities as of May 2026, with surging demand from data centers.

branding.brand_signature: AI workers or AI employees framing for energy operations
branding.community_and_virality: Press in Forbes Italia, pv magazine and Munich Startup; exhibited at smarter E in June 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional trade and startup press but little evidence of broad brand pull; name resembles inverter terms.

outcome_analysis: Invertix is a Fall 2026 YC company that raised a 1.7M euro pre-seed in May 2026 led by Vireo and reports utility customers and gigawatts under management. Too early for an outcome; incumbents like Emerson are the main threat to its enterprise integration moat.
notes: Several sources and the company site URL say 17 million; multiple outlets confirm 1.7M euro. The USD amount is one outlet's conversion (other reports say 1.9M or 2M). Seedtable lists Italian Founders Fund as lead while others say Vireo. Founding year is 2025 per press and 2026 per YC. Traction numbers are company reported. Competitor dates are year level only.
